name: cera-platform
description: CERA Medical platform - public website, service catalogue, and controlled enquiry platform

scripts.migrate: pnpm --filter api migrate && pnpm --filter cms migrate && pnpm --filter commerce migrate
scripts.seed: pnpm --filter api seed && pnpm --filter cms seed && pnpm --filter commerce seed
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist .next node_modules/.cache && rm -rf node_modules

//devDependencies: eslint and prettier are root dependencies because lint-staged resolves binaries from the root node_modules/.bin, not from the workspace a staged file happens to live in.

pnpm.//onlyBuiltDependencies: An explicit allow-list of packages permitted to run install scripts. Everything else is blocked, which is the supply-chain control reviewed in Phase 14. unrs-resolver is required: without its native binary, eslint-plugin-import-x cannot resolve TypeScript paths and every import rule silently stops working.
